tierFactors.basis: benchmark/results-effort.json (2026-11-20): totalTokens medium 168641 vs high 200219 over 13 identical tasks on mimo-v2.6-flash; outputTokens 7986 vs 9443 (0.85)
tierFactors.caveat: Measured on the benchmark suite (mostly easy tasks); the medium-vs-high gap may be larger on genuinely hard prompts. Diagnostic only - NOT used by the v1 gated metric.
tierFactors.reDerivationTrigger: A harder effort sweep, or effort-level reasoningTokens becoming visible, re-derives this factor.
